subject: The Field Kit: three things worth your time this week
preheader: Dark mode email, faster image loading, and a checklist for accessible buttons.
headline: Three things worth your time this week
body: Short reads for people who build email. Each one takes under five minutes.

items.title: Why your logo disappears in dark mode
items.text: Some clients invert colours and some do not. A transparent PNG with a thin light outline survives both.

items.title: Sizing images for retina without the weight
items.text: Export at twice the display width, then compress. The email stays sharp on a phone and well under the clipping limit.

items.title: A short checklist for accessible buttons
items.text: Real text instead of an image, enough contrast, and a tap target at least 44 pixels tall.
